name: Page versions
description: Let a client approve a site page by page: compare page versions and section variants, pick one, and track approval until everything is ready for build. Choices are kept in the project, so they commit and pull with the site.

permissions.label: Choose and approve
permissions.description: Pick the preferred version or section variant, leave a comment and approve pages.

permissions.label: Manage comparisons
permissions.description: Create comparisons, add or remove versions and reset choices.
